## Table 1: Sample demographics across attitudes (combining old and new data)

```{r codeSampledemogs_ALL, include=FALSE}
## ALL NEW+OLD DATA ----

## AGE ----
timeseriesAge$edu.grp <- ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesAge$edu.new)<5, "ncol", "col")
timeseriesAge$pol.grp <- ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesAge$politicalid)<4, "cons",
                                ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesAge$politicalid)>4, "lib", "neutral"))

age.n_ALL <- dim(timeseriesAge_NEW)[1]+dim(timeseriesAge)[1]
age.meanage_ALL <- mean(c(timeseriesAge_NEW$age.new, timeseriesAge$age.new))
age.sdage_ALL <- sd(c(timeseriesAge_NEW$age.new, timeseriesAge$age.new))
age.pfem_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$genderidentity_simp)["female"]+table(timeseriesAge$sex.new)["female"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pmal_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$genderidentity_simp)["male"]+table(timeseriesAge$sex.new)["male"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pW_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$racesimple)["White"]+table(timeseriesAge$ethnic.race.new)["White"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pB_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$racesimple)["Black"]+table(timeseriesAge$ethnic.race.new)["Black or African American"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pA_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$racesimple)["Asian"]+table(timeseriesAge$ethnic.race.new)["Asian"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pColl_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$edu.grp)["col"]+table(timeseriesAge$edu.grp)["col"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pLib_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$pol.grp)["lib"]+table(timeseriesAge$pol.grp)["lib"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pCons_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$pol.grp)["cons"]+table(timeseriesAge$pol.grp)["cons"])/age.n_ALL)
age.pNeu_ALL <- as.numeric((table(timeseriesAge_NEW$pol.grp)["neutral"]+table(timeseriesAge$pol.grp)["neutral"])/age.n_ALL)


## DISABILITY ----
timeseriesDis$edu.grp <- ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesDis$edu.new)<5, "ncol", "col")
timeseriesDis$pol.grp <- ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesDis$politicalid)<4, "cons",
                                ifelse(as.numeric(timeseriesDis$politicalid)>4, "lib", "neutral"))

dis.n_ALL <- dim(timeseriesDis_NEW)[1]+dim(timeseriesDis)[1]
```

## Table 2: Overall means and correlations of implicit and explicit attitudes

```{r codeMeans, include=FALSE}

data_new <- list(timeseriesAge_NEW, timeseriesDis_NEW, timeseriesRace_NEW,
                 timeseriesSkin_NEW, timeseriesSex_NEW, timeseriesWeight_NEW)
data_old <- list(timeseriesAge, timeseriesDis, timeseriesRace,
                 timeseriesSkin, timeseriesSex, timeseriesWeightBody)


combined_table_summary <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 6, ncol = 31))
colnames(combined_table_summary) <- c("attitude",
                                      "meanI_new", "sdI_new", "low95I_new", "high95I_new", "tI_new", "dI_new",
                                      "meanI_all", "sdI_all", "low95I_all", "high95I_all", "tI_all", "dI_all",
                                      "meanE_new", "sdE_new", "low95E_new", "high95E_new", "tE_new", "dE_new",
                                      "meanE_all", "sdE_all", "low95E_all", "high95E_all", "tE_all", "dE_all",
                                      "rIE_new", "rIElow_new", "rIEhigh_new",
                                      "rIE_all", "rIElow_all", "rIEhigh_all")
combined_table_summary$attitude <- c("age", "disability", "race", "skin", "sexuality", "body")

for (i in 1:length(data_new)){
  combined_table_summary$meanI_new[i] <- mean(data_new[[i]]$dscore)
  combined_table_summary$meanI_all[i] <- mean(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore))
  combined_table_summary$sdI_new[i] <- sd(data_new[[i]]$dscore)
  combined_table_summary$sdI_all[i] <- sd(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore))
  combined_table_summary$low95I_new[i] <- round(t.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, mu = 0)$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$high95I_new[i] <- round(t.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, mu = 0)$conf.int[2], 2)
  combined_table_summary$tI_new[i] <- t.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, mu = 0)$statistic
  combined_table_summary$dI_new[i] <- cohensD(data_new[[i]]$dscore, mu = 0)
  combined_table_summary$low95I_all[i] <- round(t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), mu = 0)$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$high95I_all[i] <- round(t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), mu = 0)$conf.int[2], 2)
  combined_table_summary$tI_all[i] <- t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), mu = 0)$statistic
  combined_table_summary$dI_all[i] <- cohensD(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), mu = 0)
  
  combined_table_summary$meanE_new[i] <- mean(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric)
  combined_table_summary$meanE_all[i] <- mean(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1))
  combined_table_summary$sdE_new[i] <- sd(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric)
  combined_table_summary$sdE_all[i] <- sd(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1))
  combined_table_summary$low95E_new[i] <- round(t.test(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, mu = 0)$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$high95E_new[i] <- round(t.test(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, mu = 0)$conf.int[2], 2)
  combined_table_summary$tE_new[i] <- t.test(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, mu = 0)$statistic
  combined_table_summary$dE_new[i] <- cohensD(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, mu = 0)
  combined_table_summary$low95E_all[i] <- round(t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1), mu = 0)$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$high95E_all[i] <- round(t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1), mu = 0)$conf.int[2], 2)
  combined_table_summary$tE_all[i] <- t.test(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1), mu = 0)$statistic
  combined_table_summary$dE_all[i] <- cohensD(c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1), mu = 0)
  
  combined_table_summary$rIE_new[i] <- cor.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_new[[i]]$attnumeric)$estimate
  combined_table_summary$rIElow_new[i] <- round(cor.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_new[[i]]$attnumeric)$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$rIEhigh_new[i] <- round(cor.test(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_new[[i]]$attnumeric)$conf.int[2], 2)
  combined_table_summary$rIE_all[i] <- cor.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), 
                                                c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1))$estimate
  combined_table_summary$rIElow_all[i] <- round(cor.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), 
                                                c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1))$conf.int[1], 2)
  combined_table_summary$rIEhigh_all[i] <- round(cor.test(c(data_new[[i]]$dscore, data_old[[i]]$dscore), 
                                                c(data_new[[i]]$attnumeric, data_old[[i]]$att.center1))$conf.int[2], 2)
}
```
